Subject: Next steps: vendor intake & payment path preference for Redwood trial

Hi John —

Great to chat this morning. Quick recap and next steps so your procurement team has a single thread to work from: 

Summary from call
- Acme Health is interested in a 6-week pilot (internal Lab group) with hosted API access.
- Procurement priority: vendor setup + clarify billing path (PO via AP vs. company card / marketplace).
- Compliance ask: SOC 2 attestation + list of data retention controls (we provided the tracker in the deck).

What we need from Acme to progress vendor setup
1) Vendor intake form & tax document: please confirm whether you need a W-9 (US) or W-8 (foreign entity).
2) Preferred payment path: PO (net 30) OR card (immediate payment) OR marketplace (AWS/Azure) — if PO, we'll route to Sales Ops for a formal purchase order invoice.
3) Banking details (ACH / wiring) only if you intend to set us up as a vendor for direct pay.

Attached: a Redwood vendor intake packet (stub) and a short W-9 request PDF for your team to route onwards. If you prefer DocuSign for the W-9, I can generate a link.

Planned internal owners
- Kimberly (sales): primary contact for SOW/pricing and pilot success criteria
- Ben (sales ops): vendor ops, invoicing and PO coordination
- Marissa (CS): pilot onboarding and technical kickoff once vendor is approved

Requested next steps (can we aim for these by end of week?):
- Procurement to confirm preferred payment path and which tax form they require.
- If PO path, please share a sample PO template or expected billing contact.
- If card/marketplace, let me know and Ben will share the quick marketplace activation checklist.

Thanks — happy to hop on a 15 min follow-up with procurement if that helps.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
[kim.park@redwood.inference]

Attachments:
- vendor-intake-packet.pdf (vendor packet stub)
- Redwood_W9_request.pdf (pdf)

Kim — thank you for the clear recap. A few datapoints from procurement: 

- Acme prefers to pay vendors via PO (net 30) where possible.
- We will need a completed W-9 (Acme is a US entity). Please provide a signed copy or a DocuSign route.
- Banking details: procurement expects vendor banking info for AP onboarding, but that usually happens after vendor acceptance. If you can provide the vendor packet and W-9, we can start the internal vendor creation.

Two quick asks: 
1) Can Ben confirm whether Redwood accepts our standard PO terms (we often request a 60-day remedy window and a mutual indemnity clause) — if you need exceptions, we can escalate.
2) Please add a contact email for invoicing (AP team) so the PO can be routed correctly.

Happy to coordinate the DocuSign if that speeds things up.

Regards,
John Doe
Sr. Procurement Manager
Acme Health

Hi John / Procurement team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. A few items from sales ops to make vendor setup frictionless: 

1) Terms & PO redlines: We can accept standard Acme PO language for a pilot under $25k without a legal review; for any indemnity/term exceptions beyond that threshold we flag to Legal. If you could share the PO template, I can confirm immediately where exceptions may be required.

2) Invoicing contact: please send the AP email. If you prefer, send a copy of the PO to billing@redwood.inference and CC procurement.

3) Banking / ACH: once the vendor packet is approved we'll request the acme_banking_form.xlsx (attached stub). For security we prefer banking details via secure portal or signed ACH form — let me know your preferred secure method and we'll match it.

4) DocuSign: Kimberly — if John confirms, I can generate a DocuSign for the W-9 and the vendor packet so procurement can sign and accelerate vendor creation.

Action items assigned:
- Procurement (Acme): share PO template and AP contact; indicate if DocuSign or secure portal is preferred.
- Ben (Redwood): prepare invoice stub, create DocuSign envelope if needed.
- Kimberly/Marissa: stand by for kickoff once vendor is active.

Thanks — looking forward to getting the pilot set up.

Best regards,
